name: Shin Yagai Gakushuu ~Nudist Camp Hen~
original_name: 新・野外学習 ～ヌーディストキャンプ編～
source: Every July the all of the first grade classes are sent on an outdoor learning trip. Mr. Ryukasaki has decided on a location, since nobody in the class seemed to have a preference. They don't want to admit that they have any interest in this learning trip. You see, this learning trip has nothing to do with school work. It's purpose is to break the students out of their shells, students who only care about their grades and nothing else. All of the students think this way, it's just the nature of attending an elite school. When they arrive at their destination they're surprised to find out that it's a nudist campsite!
translation: 每年7月，一年级的所有班级都会参加户外学习活动。班上的学生似乎都没有心仪的去处，于是Ryukasaki老师替他们决定了目的地。他们都不愿承认自己对这次活动有兴趣。其实，这次户外学习与课业无关，目的是让那些只在乎成绩的学生走出自己的小世界。所有学生都抱着这样的想法，毕竟这就是精英学校的常态。然而，抵达目的地后，他们惊讶地发现，这竟然是一处裸体主义者的营地！
